> [!WARNING]
> **Pre-release — for personal testing only.** This build is meant for trying out the functionality yourself, not for rolling out to your clients. Stability is still poor, and updates will be frequent and breaking. If you need something dependable, wait for the `0.1.0` release.

First ReClash pre-release: a cross-platform proxy client built on the mihomo core, for Android, Windows, macOS and Linux. Import a subscription, pick a node, and connect — everything below is what makes it more than a switch.

## What's inside

- Smart Routing: automatic node selection with explanations, plus a studio to tune it.
- RCX routing engine: a ladder editor with posture driven by measured network terrain.
- Provider panels: usage, expiry and dashboards surfaced from subscription headers.
- Smart Pause: stays off on trusted networks.
- Connection doctor: a live diagnostic view of the connection path, core config and traffic.
- `reclash://` links for local automation: connect, toggle, import.
- Experimental ByeDPI on Android: DPI-only mode and strategy testing.

<!-- reclash:release-epoch:1 -->

## Notice

Out of the box this build identifies itself to subscription servers with the `FlClashX/v0.4.2` User-Agent, so existing provider panels keep serving clash configs. That header is the default preset, not the only option: you can pick another client identity in settings. Thanks to the [FlClashX](https://github.com/pluralplay/FlClashX) project, whose header ReClash borrows for compatibility until panels recognize its own identity.
